title: A magazine by the manhole
situation: You are {{Markus}}, emerging from the sewers into the city at night with your team. A magazine lies on a crate beside you.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Who Is It?
facts: Federal agents are hunting the android who led the armed, organized takeover of the broadcast tower and say speculation will continue until the dangerous machine is destroyed.

media.title: Century: An Android for President?
facts: An expert panel concluded androids would govern better than humans, being incorruptible and indifferent to re-election.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: What kind of protest
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Your broadcast made you public enemy number one, and {{Jericho}} is divided. Tonight you have led your people into the city's android stores, waking hundreds of androids and bringing them into a public park. You can leave the humans a message, tagging walls, painting slogans and raising a flag, or you can trash the stores, burn the shelves and smash the city's property. {{North}} hands you a Molotov cocktail and waits.

options.text: Graffiti, slogans, a flag, and no destruction.
Smash the stores and burn what you can.

outcomes.0: By dawn the park is covered in slogans, the android symbol and a flag. The stores are untouched.
outcomes.1: Windows shatter and the stores burn. The park is littered with wreckage by dawn.

title: The two police officers
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Two police officers drove into the park and opened fire on your people, killing one. Your androids overpowered them and now have them on their knees in front of you, disarmed and terrified. {{North}} says they murdered one of yours and that humans will only respect strength. {{Josh}} says if you kill them you prove everything they say about you. The crowd is waiting for your word.

options.text: Spare them and let them go.

outcomes.0: The officers run for their car. The crowd mutters but lets them go.
outcomes.1: {{Markus}} shoots both officers. The crowd roars.
